title: "Tutorial 12 — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. Shape $(B,2)$.
2. Before each training step (after the previous `backward`), so gradients do not accumulate across steps.
3. `.grad` on tensors that require grad and participated in the graph (typically parameters).
4. Avoid building an unused computation graph; saves memory and time.
5. `__init__` (register layers / parameters) and `forward` (compute the output).
